title: Reel Deal Fishing Charter
specs: Over 500 different types of fish species to catch
blurb: Guests fish offshore for marlin, sailfish, mahi-mahi, tuna, wahoo, cobia, shark, barracuda, and other species. Reef fishing targets snapper, grouper, hogfish, yellowtail, barracuda, and more. Captain Eric has a lifetime of experience fishing in the Florida Keys and Bahamas.
highlights: Over 500 different types of fish species to catch
